title: Play First Then Screens Family Kit for Ages 2-5, 9 Printable Tools, Toddler Picture Checklist, Helping Jobs, Together Tokens, 30 Day Tracker
category_hint: Paper & Party Supplies > Paper > Calendars & Planners (or 'Chore charts') — UNVERIFIED
description:
The Play-First Family Kit for ages 2–5 has 9 printable tools, in a PDF you can type in: picture checklists, tokens, helping jobs and a family plan. It gives your day a kind shape: jobs first, then play and time together, then screens at their usual spot. Nothing is taken away; there's just more play.

The Play First, Then Screens checklist comes with big pictures for ages 2–5 and as a fillable blank. Each has 4 colorways and a Monday or Sunday start. Little ones also get a helping-jobs chart and a first-then-later Play-First Board.

The whole family gets 24 together tokens (12 ready-made, 12 blank) and six screen-spot cards, such as "5 more minutes" and "what we do next." There is a rules poster and a three-page Family Play & Screen Plan. A 30-day tracker holds 30 plays that need nothing to buy. Each has a starting age, easier and harder ways and a 2-minute version. A certificate marks the end.

Tokens are for play and time together, never screen minutes. The screen spot stays the same every day. A two-page grown-up guide covers a 2-minute setup, three talk lines and how it works from 2 to 5, plus printing, laminating and velcro tips. Every play follows our published safety rules.

You get color and low-ink files in US Letter and A4, with type-in fields for free Adobe Acrobat Reader. Instant download; nothing ships.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 9 printable tools, 41 pages (color file) = 16 checklist pages + 12 tool pages + 3 family-plan pages + 3 play-guide pages + certificate + 5 guide pages + 1 next-steps page; about 20 minutes to prep, then reusable
• Play First, Then Screens checklist: ages 2–5 pictures and a fillable blank, in 4 colorways with Monday or Sunday start
• Little helping jobs, a Play-First Board, 24 together tokens, 6 screen-spot cards, a rules poster, a 3-page family plan and a 30-day tracker whose 30 plays each have an age, easier and harder ways and a 2-minute version
• Editable where it matters: type names, dates, jobs, rules, token ideas and plan answers in free Adobe Acrobat Reader; colors and pictures can't be changed; every page also prints blank
• Color and low-ink files in US Letter and A4, plus a 2-page grown-up guide with talk lines, printing, laminating and velcro tips; every play follows our published safety rules

HOW TO DOWNLOAD
After you pay, open Etsy in a web browser (not the app), go to You > Purchases and download the files. Start with START HERE. Print at 100% / Actual size.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Personal license for one household. Please don't resell or share the files.
• Every play follows our published safety rules, with a grown-up there for every play.
• Digital download: nothing ships. Printed words are in English.
• Digital downloads can't be returned once downloaded. If a file won't open or print, or doesn't match this description, message us through Etsy and we'll fix it or refund it.

How this was made: the text, illustrations and page layout were created with AI tools for Play Before Pixels.

images.alt: 9 Play-First Family Tools for ages 2–5: Play First, Then Screens. Picture checklists, tokens, helping jobs, a family plan and a 30-day tracker. A color checklist and a “Little helping jobs” page, with two together tokens, Story together and Dance party. Labels: fillable PDF, US Letter and A4, 4 colorways.

What’s inside: 9 tools in one download, 41 pages. Tiles for: Play First, Then Screens checklists (16 pages); the Play-First Board (first, then, later); Little helping jobs; Together tokens (12 plus 12 blank); screen-spot cards; the Family Play Rules poster; the Family Play and Screen Plan; 30 Days of Play First; and a certificate.

A 2-minute grown-up guide: plain words, no lectures. Two guide pages, “Start here, grown-ups” and “How it works at each age”: set up in 2 minutes, three easy talk lines, and screens keep one steady spot in the day.

Play First, Then Screens checklist: 4 colorways, Monday or Sunday start. Four checklist pages labelled Ages 2–5 tomato, Sunday start sky, Fillable grass and Sunday start plum. Big pictures for ages 2–5, plus a fillable blank to make your own.

Ages 2–5: Little helping jobs and the Play-First Board. A page of picture jobs such as feed the pet, water plants and match socks, and the board: 1, first, jobs; 2, then, together time; 3, later, screens. Every cut piece is at least 2.1 in (5.3 cm), bigger than the toilet-paper-tube test; a grown-up keeps the pieces.

For the whole family: Our Family Play & Screen Plan. Three fill-in plan pages and the Our Family Play Rules poster, with rules such as “We play first,” “Screens have a spot in our day” and “Grown-ups play too.”

Together tokens and 30 Days of Play: tokens are for play, never screen minutes. Three token cards, Story together, Board game and Sing together, and the 30 Days of Play First tracker with a picture for each day’s play. Every play has an age and a 2-minute version.

Sizes and formats: fillable, printable, your way. A color checklist and the same checklist in low-ink line art. Notes: fillable in free Adobe Acrobat Reader on a computer or phone; you can edit text boxes (names, dates, jobs, rules, token ideas, plan answers) but not colors or pictures; pre-filled and blank pages; US Letter and A4; color plus low-ink; 5 files, START HERE plus 4 PDFs.

How to use: print, fill, play. Four steps: download in a web browser, not the Etsy app; fill in (optional) in free Adobe Acrobat Reader; print at 100%, charts on paper and tokens, cards and the board on cardstock, about 20 minutes to prep; laminate or use page protectors, with velcro for ages 3 and up only. A digital download: no physical item ships.
